lines.en: Snow's deep. Step in my tracks.

lines.zh: 冰面薄，踩我走过的地方。
lines.en: Ice is thin. Walk where I walked.

lines.zh: 四只爪子陷进雪里，一步一坑。
lines.en: Four paws sink in snow, one pit per step.
Wind's from the north. Keep going.

lines.zh: 这片冰原我走了很多年。
lines.en: I've crossed this ice field many years.
Smell fish. Down under the ice.
Cub's behind me. Slow down.
Don't run. The ice cracks.
Go around those ice spikes. They cut.

lines.zh: 雪地上只有我们的脚印。
lines.en: Only our tracks on this white field.
Each step shakes the snow off my fur.
Sea's out there. Head for the shore.
The short-legged one fell behind again.
Snow to my belly. I wade slowly.
Huff. Breath steaming from my nose.
Lick the paw. The fur's frozen.
Sit a while. The snow is soft.
Ears twitch. Only the wind.
Thick fur. Winter means little to me.
Watch the water. Wait for a fish to jump.
Back against the ice. Blocks some wind.
Yawn. My teeth are whiter than snow.
No sun today. Too cold to move.
Snow on my snout. Cold.

lines.zh: 两脚站着的东西，别靠近。
lines.en: Two-legs. Don't come closer.

lines.zh: 你在我的冰原上做什么？
lines.en: What brings you onto my ice?
I smell fish in your pack.
Back away slowly. I haven't decided.
My cub is watching you. Be careful.
Thinner than a seal. Not worth eating.
Don't raise that stick.
Your boots are slipping in the snow.
I stand up taller than you.
You've stared long enough. Say something.
Rragh. Who pricked me?
The skin on my paw is split.
This pain is nothing next to ice water.
Back off. I'm holding it in.
Fur stopped half of it. Still hurts.
I can't brace. The snow's too slick.
Don't come near while I'm limping.
Blood on the snow. Still warm.
A low growl to swallow the pain.
I've learned your smell.
Fish? Hand it over. Toss it far from you.
I don't wag for food.
That one's too small to bother with.
Set it on the ground. Then back away.

lines.zh: 你手里亮的那个，我不吃。
lines.en: That shiny thing in your hand. Not eating it.
Fish is dried. Smells of your hands.
A fish, and you expect obedience?

lines.zh: 我更喜欢自己去冰下抓。
lines.en: I'd rather fish under the ice myself.
Not enough. Bring three more.
Leave the fish. Take yourself away.
Bumped me? You're the one who stumbled.
My shoulder's harder than your shield.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我闻得到你。
lines.en: Don't press so close. I can smell you.
My paw on your foot? Your own fault.
Move. I'm going to the water.
Shove me, and I shove back.
Ice in my fur got on you. Sorry.
You're standing in front of my cub.
Don't pull my fur. It comes out in handfuls.
That was a hard bump. You all right?
I walk slowly. You had to crowd me.
Stand back. I take up room when I turn.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在冰的那一头。
lines.en: My mate's on the far side of the ice.

lines.zh: 先看幼崽，别的事以后说。
lines.en: The cub comes first. Everything else later.
Not in winter. Too cold for that.
If we pair, we carry the storms together.
You can't even catch a seal.
Ask me when the snow softens.
I keep to one mate.
Bring a big fish, then we talk.
Not now. The cub is watching.
Step aside. My mate is coming.
Fish frozen in this ice. Take it back.
A bone on the snow. Let me sniff it.
This hide will pad the cub's den.
Someone dropped a fish. Mine.
This stone won't hold against the wind.
Carry the fish properly. Don't drop it.
Paws too clumsy. Can't grip it.
A shiny stone. For the cub to play with.

lines.zh: 闻到血味，是别人吃剩的。
lines.en: Smell blood. Someone else's leftovers.
Bury it in the snow. Eat later.
My cub cried out. Who touched it?
You're too close. Stop right there.
Seal at the ice edge. Keep low.

lines.zh: 有东西在雪里动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something's moving under the snow. I see it.
That one raised a blade.

lines.zh: 护崽的时候我不讲道理。
lines.en: When I guard the cub, I don't reason.
Not a big target. One swipe is enough.
It stole my fish. Chase it.
Smell iron. A hunter.
The slow one in the snow. That's the one.
Roar first. Let them back off.
Back to the ice wall. Don't let it circle.
My paw is already raised.
Not letting this one go.
The ice cracked, and you cannot run fast either.

lines.zh: 那股味道，是从你包里来的
lines.en: That smell came from your pack.
Low growl. Closing in slow.
I stand up. Now you look up.
Take one more step. Go on, try it.
My claws are longer than your knife.
Snow crunching under me. Hear it?

lines.zh: 幼崽躲到后面去了，很好。
lines.en: The cub moved behind me. Good.
Let it move first. Then I lunge.
Slow my breath. Don't spook it.
It stepped back. Not far enough.
This ice field. Nowhere to run.
My roar rolls off the ice wall.
Eyes fixed on its shoulder.
It's starting to tremble.
Three breaths, then I move.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
Either back off, or take a hit.
There is no second road on the ice field.
You count the distance; so do I.
Do not back into the water; it is colder there.
My shadow covers your feet.
One swipe. It lands in the snow.
Rragh! Get away from my ice!
Claws rake across. A gash opens.
Jaws on the shoulder. I throw it.
It hits the ice with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 站起来往下砸，最重一下。
lines.en: Standing tall, I bring both paws down.
Don't run. I'm not done being angry.
Blood on snow. Hard to miss.
That paw was for my cub.
It's two steps back and wobbling.
Missed the bite. Again.
The snow's churned up all around us.
It's down. Stay down.
Catch my breath. Check the cub.
This paw lands on your shoulder.
The snow is gouged open by my claws.
You are at the ice crack now; careful.
I press it down and do not let go.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰到护甲，滑了一下
lines.en: My teeth hit armor and slid off.
This one was only to make it back away.
One more bear on the snowfield.
The wind woke me out of the ice.
Quiet here. A good place to settle.
Ice spikes everywhere. Hard walking.
A cub's trailing behind me already.
Find water first, then fish.
Cold enough, but my fur's thick.
Don't jump on the ice. It splits.

lines.zh: 我的地盘从这块冰到海边。
lines.en: My ground runs from this ice to the shore.
My nose is full of snow smell.
Snow settles on my back. I shake it off.
Winter's just starting. We'll endure it.
My fur's alight. Into the snow!
Slid down the ice slope. Saw stars.
Too deep. My paws can't find bottom.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡的，雪都炸飞了。
lines.en: Ears ringing. The snow blew away.

lines.zh: 一根箭挂在毛里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow tangled in my fur. Can't pull it.
The hex settles on me like a slab of ice.
Three days without a fish.
Lightning on the ice. My whole body tingles.
Nothing below. No snow at all.
